greeting: ^Ah, Barrington. I’m glad you made it out of the forest! It’s feeling dark down here. You look weary, my friend.
^I hope I can be of some help. I came across a hunk of wood here. I hear you’re building yourself a ship! It would be good for you to let yourself out of this place.
^One scientist to another, sometimes the solution we have simply is not enough. We have to try something else.
^If you’ve outgrown this place here, why not try something new yourself? There’s always an alternative!
^When you leave this place, what’s something else you might try?
artist: ^What a great idea! Creative expression is a great way to work out these different solutions.
story: ^Brilliant! I know you'll have some amazing stories to tell!
music: ^Amazing! Music is a wonderful kind of expression. I predict you'll be great at it.
farewell: ^You have a brilliant mind Barrington, I hypothesize you will find success wherever you go.
